case: Mixed-case quoted enum identifiers under transaction-local shadowed search_path
contract: A mixed-case quoted schema and enum type remain selected when lowercase-folded schema/type names lead transaction-local search_path.
Metadata lookup, keyed update, and typed filtering address the intended enum and row; native catalog checks confirm the target changed while sibling and shadow rows did not.
A label present only in the shadow enum is refused with native SQLSTATE 22P02.
Committing the transaction restores the connection's original session search_path.

identifier_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration quoted_enum_identifier_contract -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL identifier forms and session/search_path permutations remain open; this focused case does not close the PostgreSQL enum or broader B3 matrix.
